Nature’s Harmony Ecolodge
A peaceful off-grid escape in the heart of the Laurentian Mountains. Surrounded by 485 acres of pristine wilderness with remote water access views, we invite you to slow down, embrace the outdoors, and reconnect with what matters most. Whether you’re seeking solitude, adventure, or meaningful connections, your journey begins here.
Accommodations
Stay Off-the-Grid in Comfort
Our unique accommodations include cozy log cabins, geodomes, yurts, a canvas tent, and a few exclusive camping sites —perfect for reconnecting with nature in style. With seven secluded options to choose from, your escape awaits.

The Nature s Harmony Experience

Testimonials
Julie
5 stars is not enough. our stay was incredible. The surroundings are so lovely and peaceful. The night sky was beyond words. The bay was the epitome of peaceful bliss. I will for sure be coming back.
Aug 2024, Ma’ayan Chalet
Camelia
Nature’s Harmony is exactly that: harmony all around, in the middle of nature. We spent 3 nights in the Pacific Yurt, a beautiful, serene place, very clean, spacious and equipped with everything you need for your stay. Zen. The hosts are wonderful and friendly people. We ordered baked goods made by their daughter…they were delicious! Highly recommended! We spent time at the lake, hiking the trails, and relaxing in the sauna. It was a lovely weekend in a lovely place. We will be back there to experience the magic of winter!
Sept 2024, Pacific Yurt
Nancy
Nature’s Harmony exceeded all of our expectations! We found ourselves connecting with the land and to each other in unsuspecting ways as we wandered the thoughtful activities and paths along the property. Jen’s passion for nature, her dedication as a friendly, conscientious and thoughtful host, along with her desire to create memorable off-grid experiences, made our recent stay in the Little Dipper Dome a true winter highlight. Our daughter hasn’t stopped talking about the incredible Adventure Passport activities and challenges! We highly recommend taking some time to play along, no matter your age. If you are looking for an active or inactive escape into nature; don’t hesitate…just go ahead and book your stay!
Jan 2023, Little Dipper Dome
Nichole
This place was amazing!!! Felt like having a provincial park all to ourselves. My three kids aged 12,9 and 3 all loved it and there was plenty to entertain everyone. Highly recommend the little mountain hike. Manageable for everyone with a very rewarding view at the top!
Aug 2024, Shamayim Cabin

Our Story
How Nature’s Harmony was born? – the early years!
Beautiful journey began In 2002
Jen & Tzach are the owners of Nature’s Harmony and the proud parents of three children: Ella, Maya and Ethan and two beautiful Siberian Huskies, Sasha and Riley. Tzach is originally from Israel and Jen is a native Canadian, born and raised in North Bay, ON.
In 2002, we both left our home countries as independent travelers to travel the world for a year. Fate had our paths cross on foreign sands. We met in a small seaside village in Cambodia and shared an immediate connection. This led to a long process of good byes, not knowing whether we would meet again, and the shuffling of travel plans to re-unite. At the end of our travels, we both spent time in each of our home countries. Despite the obstacles of independence, distance, cultures and religions – we crossed every hurdle and we got married in Israel in 2006.
The greatest memories
For both of us, the entire travel experience was a life changing one. We first left our home countries with nothing more than a backpack and an open mind. As individuals, we allowed the experience to guide us – with no restrictions and no time constraints. We experienced different cultures, religions, foods and learned about the history of each country. In these lesser developed countries, we often sensed an inner peace that we rarely encounter back home. The experience taught us both to slow down and appreciate the simple things in life. This travel journey will always remain one of the greatest memories. However, what followed were some of the most challenging years to come. The experience changed us more than we would have ever imagined. We now wanted so much more out of life. We felt a need to make a difference in the world and to live a life that would inspire others.
We felt a need to make a difference in the world and to live a life that would inspire others.
Close to nature
In 2004, we came up with our business vision.
We spent two hard years struggling to find our purpose and meaning. In 2004, we came up with our business vision. The idea itself encompassed everything for us. We wanted to live a green lifestyle. We wanted to create and share the type of environment that we enjoyed most while traveling. We wanted to continue to meet new people. We wanted to be close to nature. And most importantly, we wanted to make a difference – whether it is sharing an eco-philosophy or inspiring others to follow their dreams. We were both excited and full of inspiration and the first place that came to mind was Mattawa because it is one of the most beautiful, yet undiscovered places in Northern Ontario. However, it didn’t take long for fear to overshadow our dream. Slowly, the dream slipped away – it never left us, but it was buried deep inside.
The dream resurfaced!
In 2006, after a number of remarkable coincidences, the dream resurfaced. Tzach was starting to study Reiki and I decided to have my first session to learn more about Reiki myself. During this session, our vision was brought back to life. This time it was clear and all the fear was removed. That very same day, when we were about to close the deal on a rental property, the listing for our current property and home came out of no where. We knew it was one of those rare opportunities that only comes once in a life time. My life philosophy has been to live a life with ‘No Regrets’. We both knew this was one of those moments that had to be seized – that we would regret later if we didn’t go for it.
We knew it was one of those rare opportunities
The next day,
The message was a little too powerful to ignore
The next day, we went to see the place and as we slowed down to turn on to the dirt road leading to the property, there was a huge wooden sign with red block letters that read, ‘No Regrets’. The message was a little too powerful to ignore and from the first moment we stepped through the front doors, we both knew this was the place to call home. The next mountain to climb was a steep one. Again, we were surrounded by the fears and doubts by all those who cared most about us. Yet, this time there was a calmness that came with knowing and believing that we were on the right path. With strength, persistence, determination and patience we finally managed to close the deal! And so the journey of Nature’s Harmony begins….
Where we are now – the later years!
It’s now been 16-years and we have learned a lot on this journey. From the outside, we often hear that we are “living the dream”. In many ways, we are…but, it hasn’t always been easy. There is a lot of hard work that goes into starting a business, striving for financial independence and raising a family at the same time.
It’s been a roller coaster ride – highs and lows and everything in between. We’ve always believed that we were meant to be here and we kept pushing forward, even in the most challenging of times. And now we are ready for the next phase of Nature’s Harmony. In December 2018, we took that next leap of faith and Jennifer left her corporate job so we could both be home to focus on the business together. Nature’s Harmony has been ready for expansion – but, it required our combined efforts. We are now planning for the next part of that journey!

Choose your Stay
Explore unique off-grid stays at Nature’s Harmony in Ontario. From cozy yurts and domes to spacious cabins and glamping tents, find your perfect nature escape for couples, families, or group retreats. Reconnect with nature in comfort and style.
Whether you are traveling alone, as a couple or in a larger group – we have something to suit everyone’s needs!
Ma’ayan Chalet
Capacity : 12
Starting Price : $300
A spacious log cabin designed for connection and community, featuring an open-concept loft, a large dining area, and a rich history of shared experiences. Ideal for retreats, gatherings, and group getaways.
Click For More Information
Pacific Yurt
Capacity : 6
Starting Price : $225
A vibrant and expansive yurt filled with natural lighting, perfect for romantic getaways, family stays, or peaceful relaxation. Cozy year-round with a wood stove and stunning natural surroundings.
Click For More Information
Shamayim Cabin
Capacity : 6
Starting Price : $200
The most secluded cabin on the property, offering a peaceful retreat near Bang’s Bay. It’s the perfect escape for couples, families, or friends seeking privacy and nature.
Click For More Information
Big Dipper Dome
Capacity : 6
Starting Price : $175
A spacious geodesic dome nestled along a creek, featuring a stunning bay window for stargazing and forest views. Perfect for those seeking adventure, tranquility, and an immersive nature experience.
Click For More Information
Little Dipper Dome
Capacity : 4
Starting Price : $170
A cozy dome retreat along the creek, offering breathtaking views, peaceful seclusion, and the perfect spot for couples or small groups to connect with nature and the night sky.
Click For More Information
Wildwood Loft
Capacity : 5
Starting Price : $160
A hidden gem for effortless comfort in the wild. This four-season glamping tent features a lofted sleeping bunk, a well-equipped kitchen, and a wood stove—blending rustic charm with modern convenience.
Click For More Information
Mongolian Yurt
Capacity : 4
Starting Price : $150
An authentic handcrafted yurt from Mongolia, accented with intricate designs and tucked away in a stunning mountain view setting. A unique and cozy retreat, perfect for unplugging and embracing off-grid living.
